summary: chore(deps): remove unused audit script, audit-filter, and .nsprc
description:
## Because

- Nothing runs the `audit` script. No CircleCI job, Nx target, shell script, husky hook, or doc invokes it.
- The repo uses Yarn 4 Berry, which has no `npm audit`, so the script cannot work even if someone ran it.
- The `.nsprc` files hold advisory exceptions from 2020 (advisories 1179, 1488, 1500). Three of them (fxa-settings, fxa-admin-panel, fxa-dev-launcher) had no script left to read them.
- BLEnder and CodeQL cover dependency security now.

## This pull request

- Deletes all 12 `packages/*/.nsprc` files.
- Removes the `audit` script from 9 package.json files.
- Removes the `audit-filter` devDependency from those same 9 package.json files.
- Refreshes `yarn.lock`, which drops `audit-filter` and its `docopt` dependency.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: FXA-5447
